WITH RECURSIVE 
  dept_hierarchy AS (
      SELECT 
        d.dept_name AS node_name, 
        NULL AS parent 
      FROM 
        Departments d 
      UNION ALL 
      SELECT 
        e.name AS node_name, 
        d.dept_name AS parent 
      FROM 
        Employees e 
      JOIN 
        Departments d 
      ON e.department_id = d.department_id
) 
SELECT * FROM dept_hierarchy 
ORDER BY parent, node_name;
